tasks.title: Normalize Stable buffering pattern across all ChemistryEngine tiers
tasks.description: ChemistryEngine has inconsistent Stable buffering: Adjacent and SameBag tiers use a skip pattern (if stableBuffer > rule.Threshold, continue -- skips the entire reaction check, doesn't raise the threshold), while WholeInventory uses the correct additive pattern (effectiveThreshold = rule.Threshold + stableBuffer). The skip pattern is wrong: Stable should raise the effective threshold, not act as a binary skip. Example: if threshold=2, stableBuffer=1, count=3, the skip pattern would NOT skip (1 < 2) and reaction fires at count=3 vs threshold=2. The additive pattern correctly makes effectiveThreshold=3, so count=3 would NOT fire. Fix: Normalize all three tiers to use effectiveThreshold = rule.Threshold + stableBuffer, then compare the computed count/magnitude against effectiveThreshold. Update unit tests to verify boundary behavior: stableBuffer raises threshold by exact magnitude, stableBuffer=0 has no effect, stableBuffer equal to count prevents reaction.

tasks.title: Implement Volatile net-hot calculation

The new system works differently: iterate each Volatile cell, compute net_hot = sum(Hot magnitudes of cardinal neighbors) - sum(Cold magnitudes of cardinal neighbors). (3) If net_hot > 0 + stableBuffer, trigger Explosion with affected cells being the Volatile cell and contributing Hot cells. (4) Null-suppressed cells (from R-3) should contribute 0 magnitude. (5) Update or replace existing Explosion tests. Add new tests: Volatile with Hot neighbor (explodes), Volatile with Hot+Cold balanced (net_hot=0, safe), Volatile with more Hot than Cold (explodes), Cold as heat shield (1 Hot + 1 Cold adjacent = safe), Volatile with no Hot neighbors (safe), Stable buffer raises effective threshold.

The puzzle is a constraint satisfaction problem: each reagent needs a (position, rotation) assignment such that no overlaps, all cells within bags, and zero negative chemistry reactions. Algorithm: constrained backtracking with pruning. (1) Solve(PuzzleState state, CancellationToken? ct = null) -> List<Placement>? -- finds one valid solution or null. (2) CountSolutions(PuzzleState state, int maxCount, CancellationToken? ct = null) -> int -- counts solutions up to maxCount. Implementation: use MRV heuristic (pick reagent with fewest valid placements first, largest/most-aspected first for tie-breaking -- same pattern as PuzzleGenerator.PlaceReagentsValidly line ~441). For each reagent, enumerate valid (position, rotation) pairs using MetaGrid.CanPlaceReagent(). For each valid placement, run ChemistryEngine.EvaluateProspective() to verify zero negative reactions. If valid, place and recurse. On failure, backtrack (remove and try next). Forward checking: CanPlaceReagent already handles overlap detection. Add configurable timeout (default 5 seconds) via CancellationToken. Reuse PuzzleSolver.ReconstructGrid(), PuzzleSolver.ReconstructReagents() for setup from PuzzleState. MUST have zero Godot dependencies. Add comprehensive unit tests: (a) known-solvable puzzle returns valid solution, (b) known-unsolvable puzzle returns null, (c) timeout returns null, (d) every returned solution passes PuzzleSolver.ValidateSolution, (e) CountSolutions matches expected count for small puzzles.

tasks.title: UIThemeLoader — sprite texture loading with fallback
tasks.description: Create src/Game/Visual/UIThemeLoader.cs — a static class that loads UI textures from art/sprites/ui/ and provides Godot StyleBox/Texture2D wrappers with graceful fallback to procedural (StyleBoxFlat/ColorRect) when files are missing. Methods: GetPanelStyleBox(string name) returns StyleBoxTexture with 9-patch margins if texture exists at art/sprites/ui/panels/{name}.png, otherwise StyleBoxFlat with dark background. GetAspectTileTexture(string aspectName) returns Texture2D from art/sprites/ui/tiles/{aspectName}.png or null. GetDecorationTexture(string name) returns Texture2D from art/sprites/ui/decorations/{name}.png or null. GetButtonStyleBox(string state) returns StyleBoxTexture from art/sprites/ui/sliced/button_{state}.png or StyleBoxFlat fallback. GetBagThemeTexture(string bagType) returns Texture2D from art/sprites/ui/sliced/bag_{bagType}.png or null. All methods log GD.PushWarning on missing files. Cache loaded textures in static Dictionary to avoid reloading. CRITICAL — Mixel avoidance: All sprite textures must render at integer multiples of their native pixel size using nearest-neighbor filtering. Sprites within the same UI layer must use the same scale factor. The sliced Kit 01 elements (buttons, header, panel) are 1x density (1px = 1 game pixel). The tileable textures and decorations are 2x density. Do NOT mix scale factors within a single panel or component. Key reference: src/Game/Visual/SpriteSwapper.cs for existing loading pattern. Sliced sprite catalog at art/sprites/ui/sliced/catalog.json.
